selection: Same model forecasts, decision-time IV, estimated cost hurdle and known-exercise-risk filter as short_vol_study; higher vol-gap gates only. Independent cohorts permit exact subset reuse of cached cash flows.
threshold_status: Post-hoc historical sensitivity requested after inspecting 3-point results; all fixed grid values reported, no independent holdout or selected optimal threshold
largest_loss_ranking: Short trades ranked by no-execution-cost net P&L, deduplicated by asset/origin/actual option expiry/strike. Models selecting the same position are listed, not counted as independent losses.
exit_override: Temporarily disable stock_replay.exercise_risk within an isolated worker using unittest.mock.patch. Fixed-exit tests set planned_exit to the original actual exit. Scheduled tests retain the original planned pre-expiry exit. Capital reserve rule and all other financial code remain unchanged.
risk_caveat: Disabling proactive exercise close is a mark-to-market diagnostic, not a safe executable strategy; actual American assignment and delivery remain unmodeled.
capital: Same 3 times entry 100-share notional. Flag any capital-reserve exit or change in holding period; do not silently treat it as a pure hedging-cost difference.
cost_audit: Reconstruct every fill against its contemporaneous cached quote, calculate quote-side spread, added stock slippage, commissions, sell surcharge, and cash flow. Reconcile sums to original results; record financing/borrow separately.
interval_attribution: Past-only interim option marks, endpoint observed liquidation mid, previous whole-share hedge, actual stock dividends. Exact option/hedge/dividend P&L; interval attribution is not a pure Greek causal decomposition.
forecast_comparison: Reproduce original model forecast to expiry, then use the same ex-ante variance curve for the actual holding window; compare separately with held-window and to-expiry RV.
